reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing shared getScheduledAmount and reuses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the approximate tolerance; the API field calls the same helper.

duplication.why: The rule lives in one function; all callers just pass their amount and operator, and the old midpoint/rounding variants are removed rather than kept alongside.

placement.why: Rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, but expectedAmount is spliced onto the result in the api.ts handler with an ad hoc intersection type instead of being produced by scheduleModel.toExternal / APIScheduleEntity in api-models.ts.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps; one unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: A single, well-commented rule with the operator as an explicit parameter; the API mapping living outside the model is a small wart.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/api.ts api/schedules-get adds expectedAmount around scheduleModel.toExternal rather than inside the API model mapping in api-models.ts

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains an op parameter (replacing the removed rangeRounding option) and one isapprox branch, which is the real variation; every caller goes through it.
